about.title: About Me
about.p1:
I believe great Front-End development goes beyond writing code. My goal is to build digital experiences that are intuitive, fast, and enjoyable for users.

I'm passionate about continuous learning and exploring new technologies that help me deliver better solutions.
about.p2:
I'm currently expanding my skills in React, Artificial Intelligence for software development, and web performance best practices to grow as a developer.

I enjoy collaborating with teams, solving complex problems, and turning designs into functional, user-friendly interfaces. I strive to write clean, reusable, and maintainable code while prioritizing accessibility, performance, and user experience.
